convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 functions (CopyClose, CopyOpen) for price data. No custom indicators, no external trading logic libraries, simple entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing. The included .mqh files (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh) are standard MT5 trade utility libraries, not trading logic.

derived_values.name: Previous daily bar direction (b)
derived_values.formula: Op1[0] > Cl1[0] => b=1 (bullish candle = buy); Op1[0] < Cl1[0] => b=-1 (bearish candle = sell)

other_exits: None - positions are set with SL/TP at entry and no other exit logic exists

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a time window filter: it only trades within 300 seconds (5 minutes) after the configured StartTime (default 00:05). Once a trade is executed (or skipped due to existing position or doji candle), the 'trade' flag is set to true and no further trades are taken until the next day's time window. The signal is derived from the previous D1 bar: if it closed lower than it opened (bearish candle), a BUY is placed; if it closed higher than it opened (bullish candle), a SELL is placed. This is a mean-reversion/daily reversal strategy. If the previous D1 bar is a doji (open==close), no trade is taken and the trade flag is set to skip the day.
python_conversion_notes: Simple daily reversal strategy. Only needs previous day's OHLC (specifically open and close). Time window filter restricts entries to a 5-minute window starting at StartTimeHour:StartTimeMinute. Position check prevents stacking. The inverted logic (bearish D1 candle -> buy, bullish D1 candle -> sell) is intentional mean-reversion. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so need to convert using point value of the symbol. No digit adjustment is performed in the EA - SL/TP are used as-is with Sym.Point(). Note: the time filter uses a 300-second window from a configurable start time, not a traditional hour range.
